text:
Sam: Starting a quick nightshift bench handoff — need pairwise perf on H100/A100/L40S for longctx-8k model (quant 4 & 8). Can someone kick off smoke runs tonight? @Lee @Anya
Lee: I can take this. Which repo/config and batch sizes? aiming for small batches to check p99 behavior.
Sam: Repo: infra/bench-harness, config: bench/longctx_8k_v2.yaml. Run: `./run_bench --model longctx-8k --quant {q} --gpu {gpu} --batch 1,2,4 --warmup 50 --it 300`. Upload to `s3://redwood-bench/nightshift/1748901112/`.
Anya: I can run L40S and A100 earlier, H100 after 22:00 on the night cluster. Do we want KV cache enabled or disabled? that changes throughput a lot.
Sam: Please run both variants (cache-on & cache-off). Add a log header with GPU driver + CUDA version and node id.
infra-bot: Scheduled bench job created: bench-job-7892 — ETA ~6h. <https://ci.redwood.example/jobs/bench-job-7892>
Mike: Heads up: there's an ongoing kernel patch on night nodes that might affect L40S perf. Recommend pinning a node pool or noting the kernel version in logs.
Lee: Good call. I'll spin up a pinned node pool `nodepool-night-bench` to isolate the runs.
Anya: Quick ask: can someone review PR #4123 (bench harness: s3 uploader + csv summary)? I want it merged before the H100 results land.
Priya: I'll take PR #4123 — starting review now.
Sam: If any regressions show up (p99 delta > 10% vs baseline `1745000000`), create an incident thread and ping eng-runtime @oncall.
Lee: :thumbsup: I'll add a tiny comparator script that checks baseline csv and posts a warning if delta > 10%.
Priya: Uploaded initial L40S runs (cache-off) to s3. path: `s3://redwood-bench/nightshift/1748901112/l40s/cache-off/*.csv`
Anya: A100 runs done. cache-on looks stable. sample p50/p95/p99 (batch=1, quant=4): 18ms / 45ms / 92ms. Uploading artifacts now.
Sam: Perfect. H100 queued on pinned pool; will post final summary in the morning. Thanks all :coffee:
infra-bot: bench-job-7892 completed. Artifacts: <https://s3.redwood.example/nightshift/1748901112/artifacts.zip>
Sam: Quick note for the run notes: include thermal logs if any temp spikes > 80C and nvlink counters for multi-GPU runs.
Lee: Added `--collect nvlink --collect thermal` to the H100 invocation. Also logging driver: `nvidia-smi -q` output.
Anya: One more thing — kernel patch Mike mentioned seems to have landed on one rack; I verified L40S nodepool is clean. tagging @Mike for visibility.
Mike: Thanks — will follow up in the incident channel if we see anomalies.
